title: Notice of compliance
rule: If a permit holder breaches the permit or its conditions, the Director may serve a notice of compliance.
points: It names the breach and the steps to fix it.
The deadline is not earlier than 21 days from service.
It can require compensation and states the penalties, including revocation.
The holder may appeal to the High Court on the listed grounds.
The Director may delegate serving notices to a forest manager and may send warning notices first, without any duty to.
